sam: main turned red on main after my small merge (docs + header reorder). tagging @maria @lee — pipeline here: https://ci.redwood/runs/12345

ci-bot: Pipeline 12345 — FAILED — job: smoke-gpu/shard-3 — exit code 1

maria: ack, grabbing logs now

sam: quick paste from failing test log:
```
allocator.cc: line 412: CHECK(kv_alloc_success) failed
stack: allocator::alloc -> kv::store -> smoke_test
seed: 4829
```

lee: hmm looks like a kvalloc assert. can someone try a rerun (maybe a flake)? I can kick one off if no objections

lee: `ci rerun 12345 --stage smoke` :gear:

ci-bot: Rerun started by lee -> https://ci.redwood/runs/12346

anya: watching the rerun. will report if it passes or reproduces

maria: update?

anya: rerun finished — reproduced same failure on shard-3, same stack and seed 4829

maria: ok this is reproducible. we should bisect the last few commits. @sam did your merge touch allocator?

sam: my merge was docs + a tiny header indentation change. not touching code paths, but it landed near some allocator churn yesterday. i'll start a narrow bisect across last 5 commits

lee: if bisect points to a code commit i can try to reproduce locally with the same seed

sam: bisect progress: narrowed to commit 9f3a2c (allocator small refactor) — opening a revert/pr for testing now

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/8901 — revert of 9f3a2c

ci-bot: PR 8901 created, CI triggered

maria: if PR 8901 fixes it we fast-track. if not, we'll continue bisect + hotspot debugging. thanks for the quick eyes. :thumbsup:

lee: i'll eyeball the allocator diff and post any suspicious lines in a minute

anya: i'll keep monitoring main pipeline and post updates to #incidents if it stays red

sam: will follow up with revert merge if green. thanks all.
